nutrient_units: Names explicitly encode g, mg, ug or kcal. Available carb excludes fiber. Per100g and per100mL differ.
unknowns: null means unknown, not zero. Free sugar is not inferred from total sugar.
references: TW label NRVs are authentic source-specific references. Food/diary values are invented.

taiwan_dri_baseline.status: Current official listed edition checked; ninth-edition draft is not substituted for the current baseline

scope: Teaching calculations, not diagnoses, food-label compliance rulings or personalized diets
